verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs explicitly document webhooks that push HTTP notifications on data create/update/delete events, with a webhookCreate mutation to subscribe programmatically, plus UI-level event subscriptions for project views feeding Inbox/Slack notifications. This directly satisfies an AI-native user's need to subscribe to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability or payload details beyond first-party docs.
